description: This file contains platform-specific functions for firmware upgrade procedures in an OpenWRT-based embedded Linux system. It includes functions to prepare the initramfs, check images, perform upgrades across various hardware models, and set environment variables relevant to the upgrade process.

methods.name: xiaomi_initramfs_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the initramfs environment by formatting MTD partitions if running on a tmpfs root filesystem.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the image; always returns success in the current implementation.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs pre-upgrade steps based on the board name, calling xiaomi_initramfs_prepare for specific Xiaomi devices.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the actual firmware upgrade procedure tailored for different hardware models.
